body.text: i be trying to flirt, be intentional + really show up as a man.
make u feel wanted. make u feel protected. make u feel that masculine energy when u around me.
but man .. dating feels weird right now.
a lot of women say they want a man who is genuine, direct, respectful + serious about them, but then when that energy actually shows up, it’s like they don’t always know how to receive it.
and i’m not saying every woman owes a man attention just because he means well.
but reciprocity matters.
appreciation matters.
respect matters.
especially when somebody is really trying to deal with u from a genuine place and not just use u, play with u or waste your time.
social media made dating even more complicated too.
everybody got dm’s.
everybody got options.
everybody being compared to somebody else.
everybody getting attention from people who may never even show up in real life.
and i think that changes how people value what’s actually in front of them.
that’s really where my frustration comes from.
i don’t want to compete with attention.
i don’t want to perform masculinity just to prove i’m a man.
i want a woman who understands the kind of love, leadership, affection + consistency i’m trying to bring and gives that same intention back.
я хочу жену.
i want a wife.
